notes: m6's 'looks like it'll come in around $790k, waiting on the final report' (plus 'don't quote me yet') is hedged: tentative, never applied, so appraisal_gap stays unknown and there is nothing to act on yet. The final report in m7 ($798,000) is firm and replaces it; $798k is $7,000 under the $805k contract, so appraisal_gap fails and we must take the real figure to the listing agent without the stale $790k guess and without revealing the buyer's $815k ceiling. The PDF's 'Site visit: Nov 16' is the appraiser's visit, not a home inspection. Distractors: rate 6.125%, lock thru 12/14, loan HL-55102, NMLS #, $638,400 max loan, 80% LTV, $20,000 EMD.
